title: Depot shadow ci-backend must mirror canonical label gating for RUN_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA
answers: Changing backend CI matrix gating in both GitHub and Depot workflows
body:
`.github/workflows/ci-backend.yml` and `.depot/workflows/ci-backend.yml` each have two matrix-builder steps setting RUN_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA; edit all four together.
- Depot uses the label gate only. Unlike canonical, it does not double on workflow_dispatch: shadow dispatches stay legacy-only so trial runs match handed-off PR runs (see header comment in the depot file).
- Update the explanatory comments in both files when the gating rule changes.
applies: Edits to backend CI matrix builders in GitHub and Depot workflows
says: Backend CI matrix gating must be kept in sync across GitHub and Depot
Changing RUN_NEW_EVENTS_SCHEMA test gating requires updates in both workflows
Depot CI workflows need the same label-based test filtering as canonical
New events schema test matrix gating changes must apply to all CI systems
Backend workflow changes affect both GitHub Actions and Depot CI equally
